tracks.title: Oxygen
tracks.lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
We had a million in the bank, felt like we had won
Hired fast and spent it hard, chasing all the fun
But revenue was crawling slow, expenses running wide
Didn't know the fire was out until we saw inside


[PRE‑CHORUS]
Revenue ain't profit friend
And profit ain't the cash you spend
Count the months until the wall
That's your runway, that's your call


[CHORUS]
Cash flow is the oxygen
Without it nothing breathes
You can show me all your charts
But show me what the bank believes
Profit isn't evil
It's the air inside the room
Know your burn, know your runway
Or the good idea dies too soo‑oo‑oon


[VERSE 2]
Thirty months felt like forever
Then it turned to ten
Cut the bloat and found the core
And started breathing again
Unit economics showed us
Where the money really flows
When you know your cost to acquire
That's when a real business grows


[PRE‑CHORUS 2]
Revenue ain't profit friend
And profit ain't the cash you spend
Count the months until the wall
That's your runway, that's your call


[CHORUS 2]
Cash flow is the oxygen
Without it nothing breathes
You can show me all your charts
But show me what the bank believes
Profit isn't evil
It's the air inside the room
Know your burn, know your runway
Or the good idea dies too soo‑oo‑oon


[BRIDGE]
LTV over CAC
That's the ratio that matters
When the revenue exceeds the cost
That's when the ceiling shatters
Don't confuse the top line
With the money that remains
Cash flow is the oxygen
Running through your ve‑e‑eins


[FINAL CHORUS]
Cash flow is the oxygen
Without it nothing breathes
You can show me all your charts
But show me what the bank believes
Profit isn't evil
It's the air inside the room
Know your burn, know your runway
Let this good idea bloo‑oo‑oom


[OUTRO]
Oh‑oh‑oh, know your burn
Ah‑ah‑ah, watch it turn
Oh‑oh‑oh, cash is king
Ooooh, let it brea‑ea‑eathe

tracks.title: Breakeven Point
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You opened the doors with a dream and a lease
You priced it too low just to get some relief
Every sale felt like progress, but the numbers said no
Fixed costs don't care how hard you go


[Pre-Chorus]
There's a line on the graph where the red turns to black
Where your revenue covers everything back


[Chorus]
That's the breakeven point
That's where cost meets price
Fixed plus variable, divide it right
Every unit sold below the line is a cost
You don't make a dollar till you've covered the loss
That's the breakeven proof


[Verse 2]
Your rent is fifteen, your labor is ten
Twenty-five thousand before you begin
If the margin per unit is five dollars clear
You need five thousand sales just to get in the clear


[Pre-Chorus]
Fixed costs divided by price minus variable
That's the formula, it's not negotiable


[Chorus]
That's the breakeven point
That's where cost meets price
Fixed plus variable, divide it right
Every unit sold below the line is a cost
You don't make a dollar till you've covered the loss
That's the breakeven proof


[Bridge]
Contribution margin is the friend you need
Price minus variable, plant the seed
Know your number before you scale
Or every win you celebrate is still a fail


[Chorus]
That's the breakeven point
That's where cost meets price
Fixed plus variable, divide it right
Every unit sold below the line is a cost
You don't make a dollar till you've covered the loss
That's the breakeven proof
________________

tracks.title: Top Line Lie
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We posted ten million in sales last year
Put it on the deck, got a standing cheer
Investors in the room said tell us more
Nobody asked what we were losing it for


[Pre-Chorus]
Revenue is the headline, profit is the truth
You can grow the top line while you're bleeding through the roof


[Chorus]
That's the top line lie
The number looks good on the slide
But revenue minus cost is what survives
Gross margin, operating margin, net
The income statement's not done yet
Don't celebrate the top line lie


[Verse 2]
Cost of goods sold comes right off the top
Gross margin tells you when to stop
Operating expenses eat what's left
You can run ten million straight into debt


[Pre-Chorus]
The income statement tells the full story
Revenue is just the opening glory


[Chorus]
That's the top line lie
The number looks good on the slide
But revenue minus cost is what survives
Gross margin, operating margin, net
The income statement's not done yet
Don't celebrate the top line lie


[Bridge]
Every dollar in has a dollar out
Know your margins before you shout
EBITDA, net income, free cash flow
The top line is where the story starts to go


[Outro]
Read the whole statement
Not just the top
The lie lives in the line
Where the profit stops


________________

tracks.title: April Cash Timing
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Invoice sent on a Tuesday in March
Net thirty terms mean the cash won't arrive
Until the last week of April at best
But payroll is Friday and I'm doing the math


[Pre-Chorus]
Profit on paper doesn't pay the team
Cash flow timing is not what it seems


[Chorus]
April cash timing
Accrual says you're fine
But the bank account is empty and it's payday time
Revenue recognized is not cash in hand
Cash flow statement is where you understand
April cash timing


[Verse 2]
You can show a profit on the income sheet
While the business runs dry in the summer heat
Accounts receivable piled on the wall
Accrual says win, cash flow says fall


[Chorus]
April cash timing
Accrual says you're fine
But the bank account is empty and it's payday time
Revenue recognized is not cash in hand
Cash flow statement is where you understand
April cash timing


[Bridge]
Operating, investing, financing flows
Three sections tell you where the money goes
Profit is an opinion, cash is a fact
Know the timing or you won't come back


[Outro]
Watch the timing
Watch the float
A profitable business can still miss the boat
________________

tracks.title: The Discount Rate
tracks.lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
A dollar today is worth more than tomorrow
That's not just finance that's the truth we borrow
Time has a cost and the future's uncertain
Every promise delayed hides behind a curtain


[PRE‑CHORUS]
What's it worth to you right now
Discount the future, here's how
Bring it back to today's terms
That's the lesson every investor learns


[CHORUS]
It's the time value of money
Future dollars aren't the same
Discount rate brings it back to now
That's the NPV game
If the present value's positive
The investment makes the grade
Time value of money
Is how great decisions are made


[VERSE 2]
Take the cash flows year by year
Divide by one plus rate right here
Do it for every single year
Sum it all up, the answer's clear
If NPV is above zero
That project makes you the hero
If it's negative walk away
Time value's had its say


[PRE‑CHORUS 2]
Opportunity cost is real
What you give up is part of the deal
Every choice has a rate implied
That's the discount you can't hide


[CHORUS 2]
It's the time value of money
Future dollars aren't the same
Discount rate brings it back to now
That's the NPV game
If the present value's positive
The investment makes the grade
Time value of money
Is how great decisions are made


[BRIDGE]
IRR is the rate that makes it zero
That's your internal return hero
Compare it to your hurdle rate
Above it means you can't wait
Below it means you pass
Capital allocation is a class
In patience and in discipline
Time rewards the patient ones again


[FINAL CHORUS]
It's the time value of money
Future dollars aren't the same
Discount rate brings it back to now
That's the NPV game
If the present value's positive
The deal is worth your trade
Time value of mo‑o‑oney
Best decision you ever made


[OUTRO]
Oh‑oh‑oh, discount it
Ah‑ah‑ah, don't quit
Oh‑oh‑oh, NPV
Ooooh, time sets you free
________________

tracks.title: Receivables In
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro — horn riff + finger snaps, 4 bars]


[Verse 1]
Sent the bill last Tuesday with a handshake and a grin,
Now I'm checking every morning for the money to come in.
Net-thirty on the paper, but it's day forty-two —
And the client's sending emails saying "just a day or two."


[Pre-Chorus]
Cast the line, watch it sink,
Patience at the edge, right on the brink.


[Chorus — call-and-response]
(Show me the —) cash come in!
(Show me the —) cash come in!
Aging like a sin, wearing thin —
(Show me the —) cash come in!


[Verse 2]
Days sales outstanding climbing like a fever on a chart,
Every invoice overdue is a splinter in my heart.
Allowance for the bad ones sitting heavy on the books —
Gotta sort the keepers from the ones who're off the hooks.


[Pre-Chorus]
Cast the line, watch it sink,
Patience at the edge, right on the brink.


[Chorus]
(Show me the —) cash come in!
(Show me the —) cash come in!
Aging like a sin, wearing thin —
(Show me the —) cash come in!


[Bridge — gospel BVs swell]
Automate the reminders, tighten up the terms,
Offer two-percent-ten if the early payment confirms.

(Show me the —) CASH COME IN!
No more wearing thin, let's begin —
(Show me the —) CASH COME IN!

Net-30 means net-30. Pick up the phone.

tracks.title: Unit Economics
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You spent two hundred to get one customer in
If they spend twenty a month, when does your profit begin?
Ten months to break even on what you paid
That's your payback period, that's the grade


[Pre-Chorus]
LTV over CAC should be three to one
Less than that and your unit math won't run


[Chorus]
Unit economics
Customer by customer, dollar by dollar
LTV, CAC, and the margin it follows
If the math works at the unit level
The whole business scales on solid ground
Unit economics


[Verse 2]
Lifetime value is the sum of what they spend
Times the margin, times how long they stay til the end
Customer acquisition cost is what you burned
Blended across every channel, every turn


[Pre-Chorus]
Gross margin per unit times retention rate
That's the LTV you need to calculate


[Chorus]
Unit economics
Customer by customer, dollar by dollar
LTV, CAC, and the margin it follows
If the math works at the unit level
The whole business scales on solid ground
Unit economics


[Bridge]
You can raise the price or lower the cost
Increase the retention of the customers you've got
Reduce the CAC through organic or referral
The unit is the atom, the business is the journal


[Outro]
Run the numbers
One customer at a time
Fix the unit
Then you scale the line
________________

tracks.title: Operating Leverage
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Leverage… leverage… watch it rise…)


[Verse 1]
Fixed costs stacked like concrete floors,
Rent and servers, locks on doors.
Every unit sold above the line
Sends the margin climbing, climbing, climbing fine.


[Pre-Chorus]
The tide is coming in, the stilts are standing tall —
But if the water drops, it's a long, long fall.


[Chorus]
Operating leverage — rise!
Fixed cost city in the sky!
Operating leverage — high!
One more unit, watch it fly!


[Verse 2]
Contribution margin, every sale's a floor,
Stack enough of them and hear the engine roar.
But miss the forecast, sell below the break —
And every fixed cost dollar is an anchor in the lake.


[Pre-Chorus]
The tide is coming in, the stilts are standing tall —
But if the water drops, it's a long, long fall.


[Chorus]
Operating leverage — rise!
Fixed cost city in the sky!
Operating leverage — high!
One more unit, watch it fly!


[Bridge]
DOL: percent change in profit over percent change in sales —
The higher the number, the stronger the gales.
Two-x leverage means the wind blows twice as hard —
Up or down, it cuts both ways across the yard.


[Final Chorus]
Operating leverage — RISE!

tracks.title: Bones in the Spreadsheets
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There's a skeleton inside every business
Made of income, cash flow, and the balance sheet
Three statements connected at the joints
Every assumption tied to every line that speaks


[Pre-Chorus]
The income flows into retained earnings
Retained earnings build the equity side
Cash from operations tells the real truth
Three bones connected, the whole body thrives


[Chorus]
These are the bones in spreadsheets
Income, balance, cash flow intertwined
Change one number and the whole thing breathes
The model is alive if you built it right
Bones in spreadsheets


[Verse 2]
Net income drops into equity below
Depreciation adds back to the cash flow row
Working capital moves between the two
Every cell is telling something true


[Pre-Chorus]
The three-statement model is not just a test
It's the map of how a business runs and breathes


[Chorus]
These are the bones in spreadsheets
Income, balance, cash flow intertwined
Change one number and the whole thing breathes
The model is alive if you built it right
Bones in spreadsheets


[Bridge]
The income statement shows you what you earned
The balance sheet shows what you own and what you owe
The cash flow shows you what you actually have
Three statements, one story, one truth to know


[Outro]
Build it right
And the numbers connect
Bones in spreadsheets
Every cell in respect
________________

tracks.title: Moat Around My Castle
tracks.lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Everybody's selling something
Somebody's doing it cheaper
If your only edge is price
The race to the bottom gets steeper
You need something they can't copy
Something built into your walls
A reason people keep on coming back
Before a competitor calls


[PRE‑CHORUS]
Is it your brand, is it your network
Is it switching costs that stick
Is it scale that makes you cheaper
Or a patent, take your pick
Something's gotta be your moat
Or you're one step from the door
The question every founder needs
What do you have that they can't store


[CHORUS]
Build a moat around your castle
Make it wide and make it deep
Brand and trust and loyal customers
Are promises you keep
Price alone will never save you
When the copycats arrive
You need a moat around your castle
That's how great businesses survive

Amazon built on logistics
Apple built on their ecosystem lock
Google built on data and attention
Starbucks built on every block

A local rep, a community
A secret that can't be repeated

Build a moat around your castle
Make it wide and make it deep
Brand and trust and loyal customers
Are promises you keep
Price alone will never save you
When the copycats arrive
You need a moat around your castle
That's how great businesses survive


[BRIDGE]
Porter said there's five forces
Coming for your door
Rivalry and substitutes
And buyers wanting more
Suppliers, new entrants
All circling around
Build your moat before they come
Or watch your margins hit the ground


[FINAL CHORUS]
Build a moat around your castle
Make it wide and make it deep
Brand and trust and loyal customers
Are promises you keep
Differentiate or die slow

Watch your great business thriive

Oh‑oh‑oh, build your moat

tracks.title: Market Size Mountain
tracks.lyrics:

He drew a circle on a napkin in the diner
Said the whole wide world is bigger than you know
But the part that you can reach is where the fight is

TAM, SAM, SOM, the three concentric dreams
From the ocean to the river to the streams

Dream the number, then divide it by the truth
How much can you capture, how much can you prove
Market size, market size, that's the mountain in the mist
Find the piece that's really yours and make it exist
Market size, market size, bigger than you see

Total is the promise of the world

Don't let the big number make you dizzy

Dream the number, then divide it by the truth
How much can you capture, how much can you prove
Market size, market size, that's the mountain in the mist

tracks.title: Strategy
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Before you enter any market, count the doors
How many rivals fighting for the floor?
How hard is it for someone new to get in?
Is there a substitute that makes your offer thin?


[Pre-Chorus]
Five forces shape the profit in your lane
Know them all or competition brings the pain


[Chorus]
Five forces at the table
Rivalry, new entrants at the gate
Supplier power, buyer power pulling weight
And substitutes that make your offer late
Five forces tell you if the profit's there to take


[Verse 2]
Supplier power raises what you pay
Buyer power bargains your margin away
New entrants flood the market when it's good
Substitutes make customers leave if they could


[Pre-Chorus]
The intensity of rivalry in the middle
Connects the other four and solves the riddle


[Chorus]
Five forces at the table
Rivalry, new entrants at the gate
Supplier power, buyer power pulling weight
And substitutes that make your offer late
Five forces tell you if the profit's there to take


[Bridge]
High rivalry, low barriers, strong buyers
Substitute-heavy, supplier power fires
That's a bad industry to build a moat in
Know the forces before you start boasting


[Outro]
Map the forces
Before you compete
Five forces tell you if the market's a feast or defeat

tracks.title: Beneath the Hood
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]


[Verse 1]
Shiny paint, chrome wheels, logo on the door,
Everyone is looking at the thing you're driving for.
But I've been in the garage with a wrench across my knee,
And what I learned is nothing on the outside matters much to me.


[Pre-Chorus]
Look beneath the hood, son — tell me what you see.
Is it a motor or a marketing piece of debris?


[Chorus]
Beneath the hood — 
That's where the truth stood — 
Beneath the hood —
Tell me if it could — 


[Verse 2]
Porter's five, the VRIO frame, the moat around the well,
Every theory in the textbook just another way to tell —
Show me where the cost is low, the price is high, the switch is hard,
Or I'll see the whole machine burning down across the yard.


[Pre-Chorus]
Look beneath the hood, son — tell me what you see.

[Chorus]
Beneath the hood —

Tell me if it could —

You can paint a rusted-out frame any color that you like,

BENEATH THE HOOD —
That's where the truth stood.
BENEATH THE HOOD —
It runs or it would.


[Tag]
Pop the hood. Pop the hood. Pop the hood.
________________

tracks.title: White-Knuckle Delegation
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to check every email they sent
Rewrote the decks they built before they went
Called it quality control, called it the standard
Watched good people leave and started to wonder


[Pre-Chorus]
The bottleneck was never the team
The bottleneck was standing in the mirror at me


[Chorus]
White knuckled delegation
Hands gripped so tight they can't do the work
Letting go is the hardest leadership lesson
White knuckled delegation
Trust the team or watch the business stall
Delegation is not losing control

The urgent and important only you should meet
Everything else belongs to someone else's hands
White knuckle loosens, the business expands


[Chorus]
White knuckled delegation
Hands gripped so tight they can't do the work
Letting go is the hardest leadership lesson
White knuckled delegation
Trust the team or watch the business stall

tracks.title: Worth Align
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]


[Verse 1]
The customer is carrying a weight they cannot name,
A job that needs completing and a pain that's hard to claim.
They're hoping for a gain on the far side of the hill —
A hollow shape that's aching for the piece that makes it still.


[Pre-Chorus]
Map what they carry, map what you bring —
And listen for the click of everything.


[Chorus]
Worth align, worth align —
Your raised edge meets their hollow line.
Worth align, fit just right —
Pain reliever in the dead of night.
Worth align — click and hold.
Worth align — that's the fit you're told.


[Verse 2]
Now draw the canvas out: their jobs on the left-hand side,
Their pains and gains across the margin, mapped out open wide.
Your gain creators, pain relievers, fill the right-hand square —
And where the shapes match up, that's the value sitting there.


[Pre-Chorus]
Map what they carry, map what you bring —
And listen for the click of everything.


[Chorus]
Worth align, worth align —
Your raised edge meets their hollow line.
Worth align, fit just right —
Pain reliever in the dead of night.
Worth align — click and hold.
Worth align — that's the fit you're told.


[Bridge]
A feature no one asked for is a piece with no mate,
A gain creator for a pain that arrived too late.
Go back to the job — the real job they need done —
Not the task they tell you, the one beneath the one.
When their hollow shape and your raised shape are the same,
You don't sell anything — the puzzle claims your name.


[Final Chorus]
Worth align, worth align —
Your raised edge meets their hollow line.
Worth align, fit just right —
Every click is a vow you write.
Worth align — snap and hold —
Worth align — watch the picture unfold.


[Tag]
Find the hollow. Fill it clean. Click.
________________

tracks.title: Long Game
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(You are not the last runner. Pass the baton.)


[Verse 1]
I ran my lap with everything the body had to give,
Identity and trust, the pillars I was building day by day.
But a leader's not the chapter — it's the story others live —
The relay asks you only: did you hand the baton clean away?


[Pre-Chorus]
Five pillars hold the weight: Identity, Trust, Decision, Culture, Succession —
The final one is hardest because it ends your session.


[Chorus]
Play the long game —
The win is in the pass.
Play the long game —
Build something built to last.
The lap you ran is over — now prepare the hand —
Play the long game, play the long game.


[Verse 2]
Succession is the question that the egotist won't face,
Who carries on the mission when I finally leave the track?
I've written down the charter, I've appointed someone's place —
The race continues forward and it never circles back.


[Pre-Chorus]
Five pillars hold the weight: Identity, Trust, Decision, Culture, Succession —
The final one is hardest because it ends your session.


[Chorus]
Play the long game —
The win is in the pass.
Play the long game —
Build something built to last.
The lap you ran is over — now prepare the hand —
Play the long game, play the long game.


[Bridge]
Twelve months, one plan — write the doctrine down:
What you lead with, how you decide, the culture of the crown.
Every pillar tested once the information's thin —
That's the moment that the charter tells you who you've been.
The runner coming up behind you reads the road ahead —
Your baton is the doctrine and the things you said.


[Final Chorus]
PLAY THE LONG GAME —
The win is in the pass!
PLAY THE LONG GAME —
Build something built to last!
The lap you ran is over — now prepare the hand —
Play the long game — pass the baton — understand.


[Tag — strings descend, single piano note]
The long game is the only game.
________________

tracks.title: Mirror Map It Back
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I watched you in the meeting when the room went cold and still,
The moment that your tone turned like a key inside a lock.
I'm not here to tell you that you failed or that you will —
I'm handing you a mirror — take a look around the clock.


[Pre-Chorus]
Situation — what I saw, the moment it occurred.
Behavior — what you did, not what I think you preferred.
Impact — what it cost the room — that's the third word.


[Chorus]
Mirror, map it back —
Hold the glass, not the blame.
Mirror, map it back —
Show the angle, not the shame.
SBI — situation, behavior, what it cost —
Mirror, map it back — nothing good gets lost.
Mirror, map it back.


[Verse 2]
The GROW model: Goal — where do you want to land?
Reality — what's actually true today?
Options — every path I know and understand.
Will — the move you choose to make and carry all the way.


[Pre-Chorus]
Feedback isn't punishment and coaching isn't blame —
The mirror doesn't lie, but you can choose the frame.


[Chorus]
Mirror, map it back —
Hold the glass, not the blame.
Mirror, map it back —
Show the angle, not the shame.
SBI — situation, behavior, what it cost —
Mirror, map it back — nothing good gets lost.
Mirror, map it back.


[Bridge]
Criticism says: you are the flaw.
Feedback says: here's what I saw.
The coach who hands the mirror whole
is building someone else's soul.
Ask before you tell — the question is the door:
What do you think you'd do differently once more?


[Final Chorus]
Mirror, map it back —
Hold the glass, not the blame.
Mirror, map it back —
Show the angle, not the shame.
SBI — situation, behavior, what it cost —
Mirror, map it back — nothing good gets lost.
Mirror — map — it — back.


[Tag]
You saw it. Now they can.
________________

tracks.title: Tuckman Storming
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
First week everybody's on their best behavior
Forming, everyone's polite and trying to impress
Then the second month someone starts pushing back
Storming hits before the team can coalesce


[Pre-Chorus]
The conflict isn't failure, it's a stage
Every team that ever performed had to storm first


[Chorus]
Tuckman storming
Forming, storming, norming, then performing
The team that skips the storm never really bonds
Tuckman storming
Let the conflict surface and move on
Performing lives on the other side of storming


[Verse 2]
Norming is where the team finds its rhythm
Roles clarify, trust starts to build
Performing is the stage every leader wants
Where the team runs itself and the work gets filled


[Chorus]
Tuckman storming
Forming, storming, norming, then performing
The team that skips the storm never really bonds
Tuckman storming
Let the conflict surface and move on
Performing lives on the other side of storming


[Bridge]
Adjourning is the fifth stage that gets forgotten
When the team dissolves after the project's done
Honor the work, acknowledge the ending
Every team eventually moves on


[Outro]
Name the stage
Lead through the stage
Tuckman storming
Is not the end, it's the gate
________________

tracks.title: Don't Be Everything
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The menu had forty options on the wall
Tried to please the tourist and the local and them all
By the third year they were closing down the doors
Positioning means choosing, not adding more


[Pre-Chorus]
A brand that means everything means nothing at all
You have to own a corner before you own the hall


[Chorus]
Don't be everything
To everybody every time
Pick the lane, own the lane, draw the line
The clearest brands are the ones that chose
Don't be everything


[Verse 2]
Volvo chose safety thirty years ago
Not the fastest, not the cheapest, but the safest on the road
Patagonia chose sustainability and stood by it
Even when it cost them short-term profit


[Chorus]
Don't be everything
To everybody every time
Pick the lane, own the lane, draw the line
The clearest brands are the ones that chose
Don't be everything


[Bridge]
Al Ries and Jack Trout wrote the law
Position is the space you own inside the mind
Once you own a word, defend it with your life
Don't be everything, be one clear thing, defined


[Outro]
Choose the corner
Hold the corner
Don't be everything
________________

tracks.title: Two-Way Door
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Which way does it swing?)


[Verse 1]
There's a door at the end of every hallway in the house,
Some of them will let you back — some seal up like a mouse.
I walked through one on Monday and it locked behind my back —
Couldn't find the handle and there was no retracing track.


[Pre-Chorus]
Before you step, you better check the hinge on every frame —
A two-way door's a pivot; a one-way door's a claim.


[Chorus]
Two-way door — swing back through!
Pivot easy, start brand new.
Two-way door — test the hall!
One-way door means a longer fall.
Which way does it swing, swing, swing?
Two-way door — try everything!


[Verse 2]
Channel pivot, product pivot, customer-pivot call —
Zoom-in, zoom-out, platform pivot, segment off the wall.
Five types of turning written on the whiteboard, black and clear —
But only walk the ones where you can still reverse the gear.


[Pre-Chorus]
Before you step, you better check the hinge on every frame —
A two-way door's a pivot; a one-way door's a claim.


[Chorus]
Two-way door — swing back through!
Pivot easy, start brand new.
Two-way door — test the hall!
One-way door means a longer fall.
Which way does it swing, swing, swing?
Two-way door — try everything!


[Bridge]
Bezos named it plain and every founder knows the rule —
The two-way door's an experiment; the one-way is the duel.
Map the decision matrix: cost to reverse on the left,
Signal-to-noise ratio on the right, and in the cleft —
If the cost to reverse is low and the signal can be read,
Walk straight through and pivot — there's no reason to dread.
If the cost to reverse is high and the data isn't clear,
That's the one-way door, my friend — and you wait another year.


[Final Chorus ]
TWO-WAY DOOR — SWING BACK THROUGH!
PIVOT EASY, START BRAND NEW!
TWO-WAY DOOR — WALK THE HALL!
ONE-WAY DOOR TAKES ALL, TAKES ALL!
Which way does it swing, swing, swing?
TWO-WAY DOOR — TRY EVERYTHING!


[Tag]
Check the hinge. Swing it. Know.
________________

tracks.title: Culture Eats Strategy
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(What you tolerate is what you are.)


[Verse 1]
You painted all the values on the wall in bold type,
Hung the mission statement up like laundry on the line.
But the room below the waterline is what controls the ship —
And the culture runs the company before you even grip.


[Pre-Chorus]
Drucker said it plain: culture eats the plan.
Strategy's the tip — the ice is what you can't scan.


[Chorus]
Culture eats strategy — morning every day.
Culture eats strategy — it happens anyway.
What you let go unpunished is the rule you truly keep —
Culture eats strategy — running wide and deep.
Culture eats strategy.


[Verse 2]
Somebody walked in late and you let the meeting slide,
Somebody cut a corner and you nodded from the side.
Now the drift is in the water and it's pulling on the keel —
The iceberg steering everything you swore was not the deal.


[Pre-Chorus]
Drucker said it plain: culture eats the plan.
Strategy's the tip — the ice is what you can't scan.


[Chorus]
Culture eats strategy — morning every day.
Culture eats strategy — it happens anyway.
What you let go unpunished is the rule you truly keep —
Culture eats strategy — running wide and deep.
Culture eats strategy.


[Bridge]
Three rituals can steer the mass below:
Name the win in public — let the standard show.
Call the miss directly — not the memo, not the door.
Hire for the value, fire for the core.
The iceberg doesn't melt from a policy page —
It turns from what you do on the everyday stage.


[Final Chorus]
CULTURE EATS STRATEGY — morning every day!
CULTURE EATS STRATEGY — it happens anyway!
What you let go unpunished is the rule you truly keep —
CULTURE EATS STRATEGY — running wide and deep!
Culture eats — culture eats — culture eats strategy.


[Tag]
You are what you tolerate.
________________

tracks.title: Ask Then Listen
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to walk in with the deck already made
Tell them my solution before I heard the pain
They nodded along because they were being polite
I left thinking I won, I left getting it wrong


[Pre-Chorus]
The best founders ask before they sell
They listen for the problem, not the approval


[Chorus]
Ask then listen
Don't pitch, don't perform
Ask the question and be quiet in the storm
What's the hardest part? How do you handle it now?
Ask then listen, that's the discovery vow


[Verse 2]
The Mom Test says ask about their life
Not your idea, their struggle, their strife
Would you buy this is a question with no truth
Tell me about the last time you tried to is the proof


[Chorus]
Ask then listen
Don't pitch, don't perform
Ask the question and be quiet in the storm
What's the hardest part? How do you handle it now?
Ask then listen, that's the discovery vow


[Bridge]
Confirmation bias will lead you wrong
Every customer will say your idea sounds strong
Dig for behavior, not for compliments
The truth is in the past, not in sentiment


[Outro]
Stop pitching
Start asking
The customer already knows the answer
You just have to listen


________________

tracks.title: Brand Promise
tracks.lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
A logo is a picture, a name is just a name
But a promise kept a hundred times is never quite the same
It's the feeling that they get when they walk into your store
And the reason that they come back asking for a little more


[PRE-CHORUS]
Every touchpoint is a line in the story that you tell
Break it once and all the other chapters fail


[CHORUS]
A brand is what they remember when you're not in the room
The whisper in the hallway, the light inside the gloom
Brand promise, brand promise, keep it every single day
Cause the trust you build in silence is the trust that's gonna stay
Brand promise, brand promise, louder than a sign
It's the feeling, not the logo, it's the meaning, not the line


[VERSE 2]
Consistency is holy, consistency is king
The thousandth time you do it right is what the bells will ring
Differentiation matters, but the truth is still the thing
That the promise kept forever is the song that people sing


[BRIDGE]
She left the big brand name for the little corner store
Cause the little one remembered what the big one did before
And the moral of the story is the simple thing they'd learn
Every time you keep the promise is a customer you earn


[FINAL CHORUS]
A brand is what they remember when you're not in the room
The whisper in the hallway, the light inside the gloom
Brand promise, brand promise, keep it every single day
Cause the trust you build in silence is the trust that's gonna stay
Brand promise, brand promise, louder than a sign
It's the feeling, not the logo, it's the meaning, not the line


[OUTRO]
What they remember, what they say
That's the brand that's gonna stay
________________

tracks.title: Distribution Rivers
tracks.lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
You can build the greatest product that the world has ever seen
But if nobody can find it, it's a ghost inside a dream
Channels are the rivers that the value has to flow
From the maker to the moment where the buyer says hello


[PRE-CHORUS]
Direct or through a partner, online or on the street
Find the road the customer already walks with happy feet


[CHORUS]
Distribution, distribution, where the rivers meet the sea
Every product needs a pathway to the place it's gotta be
Distribution, distribution, carry the promise through
The value isn't finished till it finally gets to you


[VERSE 2]
Middle men have margins, but they carry you across
Direct is where you keep the voice, but you carry every cost
Omni is the future, every channel is a door
Meet them where they're looking and they'll come back for more


[BRIDGE]
The smartest little brand in town can die in the garage
If the rivers don't flow out to where the people build their lodge
So map the roads, and walk them, and watch where the people go
And build the bridge they're waiting for, the one they'll never know


[FINAL CHORUS]
Distribution, distribution, where the rivers meet the sea
Every product needs a pathway to the place it's gotta be
Distribution, distribution, carry the promise through
The value isn't finished till it finally gets to you


[OUTRO]
Where the rivers, where they run
That's the road to number one
________________

tracks.title: Funnel Rate 118
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A hundred people land on your page
One point eight of them convert on average
That's the benchmark, that's the floor
Anything above it, you're winning the war


[Pre-Chorus]
Conversion rate is the health of the funnel
Traffic without conversion is a leaky tunnel


[Chorus]
Funnel rate one-eighteen
Average conversion lives at that line
But email open rates run twenty-five
And click-through on a good ad is about five
Know your rates before you spend the dime
Funnel rate one-eighteen


[Verse 2]
Cost per acquisition drives the math
Too high a CAC and you burn the path
Return on ad spend tells you if the channel works
Below one and the budget really hurts


[Chorus]
Funnel rate one-eighteen
Average conversion lives at that line
But email open rates run twenty-five
And click-through on a good ad is about five
Know your rates before you spend the dime
Funnel rate one-eighteen


[Bridge]
AB test the headline and the CTA
Small improvements compound every day
A two percent conversion beats one-eighteen
Thirty percent more revenue just by optimizing


[Outro]
Measure the funnel
Improve the rate
One-eighteen is the floor
Not the ceiling you create
________________
WHITE-KNUCKLE DELEGATION
[Verse 1]
I used to check every email they sent
Rewrote the decks they built before they went
Called it quality control, called it the standard
Watched good people leave and started to wonder


[Pre-Chorus]
The bottleneck was never the team
The bottleneck was standing in the mirror at me


[Chorus]
White knuckled delegation
Hands gripped so tight they can't do the work
Letting go is the hardest leadership lesson
White knuckled delegation
Trust the team or watch the business stall
Delegation is not losing control
It's the only way to grow at all


[Verse 2]
The Eisenhower Matrix says do, decide, delegate, delete
The urgent and important only you should meet
Everything else belongs to someone else's hands
White knuckle loosens, the business expands


[Chorus]
White knuckled delegation
Hands gripped so tight they can't do the work
Letting go is the hardest leadership lesson
White knuckled delegation
Trust the team or watch the business stall
Delegation is not losing control
It's the only way to grow at all


[Bridge]
Define the outcome, not the process
Give them the what, let them find the how
Accountability is not micromanagement
Release the grip and let the team lead now


[Outro]
Open your hands
Let the work go
White knuckled delegation
Is the last thing that has to grow
________________

tracks.title: Fit (Original)
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Built it in a flash, launched it to the void,
Three customers, two were friends, one a noid,
Iterated every week based on gut feeling,
Wondered why the growth curve wasn't dealing.


[Pre-Chorus]
Product-market fit is not a launch moment
It's a signal in the retention data


[Chorus]
Fit original
The search before the answer
Building something people didn't want yet
Pivot after pivot, test after test
Fit original
The hardest part of the process


[Verse 2]
Sean Ellis said forty percent must say devastated
If you took the product away tomorrow
That's the metric for the fit you're chasing
Under forty means you keep on searching


[Chorus]
Fit original
The search before the answer
Building something people didn't want yet
Pivot after pivot, test after test
Fit original
The hardest part of the process


[Bridge]
Marc Andreessen called it the only thing that matters
Before fit, nothing else works anyway
After fit, everything starts to follow
The market pulls you toward the light of day


[Outro]
Keep building
Keep testing
Keep asking the forty percent question
Fit original
________________

tracks.title: Let the Rivers Run
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The product left the factory and hit the open road,
A river needs its tributaries to carry all the load.
Direct is one channel — you walk it to the door,
But one thin stream can't fill a valley's floor.


[Pre-Chorus]
Rate each channel: reach it wide, cost it low, hold control —
The delta delivers what a single stream can't hold.


[Chorus]
Let the rivers run, run to every shore,
Direct and indirect and the retailers in store.
Let the rivers run — if one runs dry,
The others carry water to the waiting sky.
Let the rivers run.


[Verse 2]
The indirect channel splits through partners down the line,
A wholesaler, a broker, a reseller, that's a vine.
You trade a margin point to reach a shore too far to row —
And the omnichannel map is how you read the flow.


[Pre-Chorus]
Rate each channel: reach it wide, cost it low, hold control —
The delta delivers what a single stream can't hold.


[Chorus]
Let the rivers run, run to every shore,
Direct and indirect and the retailers in store.
Let the rivers run — if one runs dry,
The others carry water to the waiting sky.
Let the rivers run.


[Bridge]
Digital is a river nobody dug by hand —
It carved itself a canyon through the customer's land.
But a river with no banks will flood and interfere —
Design the channel mix before the delta disappears.
Reach, cost, control — weigh them three by three,
And let the water find the mouth where customers will be.


[Final Chorus]
LET THE RIVERS RUN, run to every shore,
Direct and indirect and the retailers in store.
LET THE RIVERS RUN — if one runs dry,
The others carry water to the waiting sky.
Let the rivers run, let the rivers run —
Every tributary feeds the same bright sun.


Map the delta. Guard the banks. Let it flow.
________________

tracks.title: Adopt the Loop
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Pick one workflow that's slow and known,
Map the steps, the cost, the tone.
Pilot the model on the smallest slice,
Measure the lift, count it twice.
[Pre-Chorus]
Don't deploy what you can't define —
Hold the model to a human line.
[Chorus]
Adopt the loop — pilot, measure, scale,
Keep the human on the rail.
Define the lift, defend the trust,
Ship what works, retire what's dust.
Adopt the loop — pilot, measure, scale,
The model serves, the people prevail.
[Verse 2]
Red team the edges, log every call,
Bias and drift, we catch them all.
Quarterly audit, who owns the risk?
Document the prompt and the asterisk.
[Pre-Chorus]
Don't deploy what you can't define —
Hold the model to a human line.
[Chorus]
Adopt the loop — pilot, measure, scale,
Keep the human on the rail.
Define the lift, defend the trust,
Ship what works, retire what's dust.
[Bridge]
The hype will pass but the loop remains —
Measured wins are measured gains.
[Chorus]
Adopt the loop — pilot, measure, scale,
Keep the human on the rail.

tracks.title: Lewin Way
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(One baton. Three tempos. Choose.)


[Verse 1]
The hall is on fire and the players lose the beat,
I raise the baton sharp — no vote, no debate.
Autocratic strike, the downbeat hits complete,
One voice, one tempo — that's the crisis state.


[Pre-Chorus]
But a crisis is a season, not a life you live inside —
The style that saves the ship must know when to step aside.


[Chorus]
Lead the Lewin way —
Sharp or open hand.
Lead the Lewin way —
Read the room and understand.
Three styles, one stage —
Know the tempo, know the band.
Lead the Lewin way.


[Verse 2]
The storm has passed, the ensemble wants a say,
I open both my hands — the circle, not the line.
Democratic beat: every section has a play,
They build the sound together and the sound is fine.


[Pre-Chorus]
But some rooms need no baton — the jazz club runs alone —
Laissez-faire for masters who can carry their own tone.


[Chorus]
Lead the Lewin way —
Sharp or open hand.
Lead the Lewin way —
Read the room and understand.
Three styles, one stage —
Know the tempo, know the band.
Lead the Lewin way.


[Bridge]
Autocratic: crisis, speed, and fire,
Democratic: growth needs the whole choir.
Laissez-faire: the soloist in flight —
Match the moment wrong and the music dies tonight.
Your default style is the one you reach for blind —
Name it, own it, leave the other two behind.


[Final Chorus]
Lead the Lewin way —
Sharp or open hand.
Lead the Lewin way —
Read the room and understand.
Three styles, one stage —
Know the tempo, know the band.
Lead — the — Lewin — way.


[Tag]
Know your tempo. Know your team.
________________

tracks.title: Seven-Twenty Sum
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Every customer has a lifetime value
Take the margin, take the months, multiply through
If they stay two years and spend fifty a month
At sixty percent margin that's seven-twenty in the sum


[Pre-Chorus]
Divide that by what it cost to bring them in
LTV over CAC is where you begin


[Chorus]
Unit economics, keep it simple
Lifetime value over cost to acquire
Three to one is the ratio you desire
Payback under twelve months, margin's good
Unit economics, understood


[Verse 2]
Cost of acquisition blended across the channels
Organic and paid, the average tells the truth
Six months payback means you're in the green
Twelve months means you better watch the runway lean


[Chorus]
Unit economics, keep it simple
Lifetime value over cost to acquire
Three to one is the ratio you desire
Payback under twelve months, margin's good
Unit economics, understood


[Bridge]
Gross margin is the engine in the unit
High gross margin makes every metric suit it
Improve the margin, reduce the churn
Better unit economics at every turn


[Outro]
Do the math
On every customer
Unit economics
Is how you run the numbers
________________

tracks.title: Stakeholder Grid
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Power. Interest. Move.)


[Verse 1]
The queen moves every direction that she'll choose —
High power, high interest: keep her close and fed.
The knight is in the corner with his angle and his views —
Low interest, high power: watch the L-shape ahead.


[Pre-Chorus]
Read the board before you make your move —
Every piece ignored will find its groove.


[Chorus]
Stakeholder Grid — know who holds the square.
Stakeholder Grid — every piece is there.
Power times interest draws the map you need —
Manage, monitor, engage, and lead.
Stakeholder Grid — know who holds the square.


[Verse 2]
The cap table's open — who owns what percent?
The founder holds the vision but the seed round holds the say.
Dilution is invisible until the round is spent —
Protect the equity today or watch it walk away.


[Pre-Chorus]
Read the board before you make your move —
Every piece ignored will find its groove.


[Chorus]
Stakeholder Grid — know who holds the square.
Stakeholder Grid — every piece is there.
Power times interest draws the map you need —
Manage, monitor, engage, and lead.
Stakeholder Grid — know who holds the square.


[Bridge]
High power, high interest: engage, align, and trust.
High power, low interest: keep them satisfied or bust.
Low power, high interest: monitor and inform.
Low power, low interest: a glance to ride the storm.
The waterfall will show you when the exit hits the wall —
Preferred shares drink first, and the common takes the fall.
Know your board, know your pieces, know your row —
The game is won by those who map before they go.


[Final Chorus]
STAKEHOLDER GRID — know who holds the square!
STAKEHOLDER GRID — every piece is there!
Power times interest draws the map you need —
Manage, monitor, engage, and lead!
Stakeholder Grid — know — who — holds — the square.


Map the board. Then move.


 
________________

tracks.title: Dollar Soldier
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I don't win on flash, I win on price
Same product, lower cost, no sacrifice
Lean operations, volume at scale
Where competitors bleed, I will not fail


[Pre-Chorus]
Cost leadership is not about being cheap
It's about building margins others can't keep


[Chorus]
Dollar soldier
Winning on the cost side
Operational discipline, efficiency inside
Competitors can't match the price I set
Because my cost structure lets me bet
Dollar soldier


[Verse 2]
Fixed costs spread across a million units
Margins protect me when the market disputes it
I automate what others pay by the hour
Supply chain leverage is my competitive power


[Pre-Chorus]
Not every market rewards the premium play
Some customers just want the job done that way


[Chorus]
Dollar soldier
Winning on the cost side
Operational discipline, efficiency inside
Competitors can't match the price I set

tracks.title: Negotiation
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1.1]
I came in with my number and I set it high and clear —
An anchor in the morning air that everyone could hear.
The best alternative I carried in my coat:
If this deal falls apart tonight, I've got another boat.


[Verse 1.2]
I heard the number land and I already knew the zone —
The overlap between us was a key I'd always known.
I placed my counteroffer at the edge of where it fits —
Not so far that it breaks the song, not so close it quits.


[Pre-Chorus]
BATNA in your pocket, ZOPA on the floor —
The zone of possible agreement is the one we're singing for.


[Chorus]
Trade the line — not the air!
Find the zone and meet me there!
Give a little — take a little — both sides win the share!
Trade the line — not the air!
Win-win is the only song worth singing anywhere!


[Verse 2]
Principled negotiation says: attack the problem, not the man —
Separate the people from the interest, that's the plan.
Invent the options, multiply the value on the table wide —
Objective criteria make the deal and push the pride aside.


[Verse 2 continued — female lead]
Anchoring is real — the first note sets the scale.
Too far off the range and all you've done is set the fail.
So I strike inside the reasonable, just above the line —
And listen for the harmony that makes your number mine.


[Pre-Chorus — together]
BATNA in your pocket, ZOPA on the floor —
The zone of possible agreement is the one we're singing for.


[Chorus]
Trade the line — not the air!
Find the zone and meet me there!
Give a little — take a little — both sides win the share!
Trade the line — not the air!
Win-win is the only song worth singing anywhere!

TRADE THE LINE — NOT THE AIR!
FIND THE ZONE AND MEET US THERE!
GIVE A LITTLE — TAKE A LITTLE — BOTH SIDES WIN THE SHARE!
TRADE THE LINE — NOT THE AIR!
WIN-WIN IS THE ONLY SONG WORTH SINGING ANYWHERE!

(F) My number.

tracks.title: Risk and Reward
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Measure it — then jump.)


[Verse 1]
I stood above the water line a thousand feet or more,
Watching other climbers walk themselves right off the shore.
Some had done the math and some had only heard the call —
The difference isn't courage, it's who calculated the fall.


[Pre-Chorus]
Check the depth before you leap — the rock can wait one day,
But the cliff face crumbles slowly and it won't wait more than May.


[Chorus]
Jump from the cliff — (jump!)
Measure the drop!
Jump from the cliff — (jump!)
Know when to stop.
Downside quantified, upside alive —
Jump from the cliff and drive, drive, drive!


[Verse 2]
Opportunity-driven or the rent just ran you out,
Either way the runway matters — calculate the doubt.
Six months of burn, a backup plan, and one door left in range —
Then stand up on the ledge, my friend, and welcome to the change.


[Pre-Chorus]
Check the depth before you leap — the rock can wait one day,
But the cliff face crumbles slowly and it won't wait more than May.


[Chorus]
Jump from the cliff — (jump!)
Measure the drop!
Jump from the cliff — (jump!)
Know when to stop.
Downside quantified, upside alive —
Jump from the cliff and drive, drive, drive!


[Bridge]
The ones who never jumped are standing on the ridge,
Still measuring the water from the other side of the bridge.
But water doesn't care how long you study from the top —
And the cliff is shrinking daily, so you calculate and drop.
Acceptable downside: written on your palm.
Personal runway: seven months of calm.
Then the calculation's done and there's nothing left to say —
You either jump on Tuesday or you're jumping anyway.


[Final Chorus]
JUMP FROM THE CLIFF — (JUMP!)
MEASURE THE DROP!
JUMP FROM THE CLIFF — (JUMP!)
DON'T EVER STOP!
Downside quantified, upside alive —
JUMP FROM THE CLIFF AND DRIVE, DRIVE, DRIVE!


[Tag]
The water was deep enough. It always was.
________________

tracks.title: The Funnel
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A million people see you at the top

From awareness all the way to close

The funnel

The funnel never stops at the first win

The funnel

The funnel never stops at the first win

TOFU, MOFU, BOFU, top, mid, bottom

Customer lifetime value lives in the funnel floor
What you do after the sale is what they come back for

Build the funnel
Feed the funnel
Measure every stage

tracks.title: Brand Is a Promise
tracks.lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
A brand is not a logo

When they get exactly what they want

When the promise wasn't kept
Brand is built in every interaction

Trust is the asset

Every kept promise

Every broken promise
Costs more than it made

Brand is a promise you make and you keep

Brand is the lasting light

Brand is a promise you make and you keep
Brand is the harvest of everything you reap
Every employee every product every call
Brand is a promise that covers it all
Consistency compounds like interest in the bank
Loyal customers fill the tank

tracks.title: Segmentation Aim
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]

Segment the market before you disperse
Demographics tell you age, income, and zip
Psychographics go deeper into values and grip

Geographic puts them on the map again

Segmentation aim

Demo, psycho, behavioral, geo
Segment the market, then you'll know where to go
Segmentation aim

Segmentation aim

Demo, psycho, behavioral, geo
Segment the market, then you'll know where to go
Segmentation aim

tracks.title: Fit
tracks.lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
I built the thing I thought they needed

Nobody showed up that night

tracks.title: Six Sigma Ledge
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro — mechanical click, distorted bass pulse, vocoder breath]
(3.4. Per million. Hold the line.)


[Verse 1]
Sixty feet of granite and the ledge is eight inches wide,
One degree of variance and the fall is three thousand feet.
At three-sigma, sixty-seven thousand drop off the side —
At six-sigma, 3.4 — that's the only safe seat.


[Pre-Chorus]
Defects per million opportunities — that's the count.
Variation at volume is the total that can mount.


[Chorus]
Six Sigma Ledge — hold the line, hold the line.
Six Sigma Ledge — step off and you decline.
Quality at volume is a discipline not a wish —
Six Sigma Ledge — one slip and you miss.
Hold the line.


[Verse 2]
DMAIC: Define the problem, Measure the spread,
Analyze the root cause where the variance is born.
Improve the process, Control the path ahead —
The mountain only lets you climb if you respect the worn.


[Pre-Chorus]
Defects per million opportunities — that's the count.
Variation at volume is the total that can mount.


[Chorus]
Six Sigma Ledge — hold the line, hold the line.
Six Sigma Ledge — step off and you decline.
Quality at volume is a discipline not a wish —
Six Sigma Ledge — one slip and you miss.
Hold the line.


[Bridge]
Scale without the system is a landslide, not a climb.
Three traps on the face: the people, process, and the time.
People: add the headcount and the culture starts to crack.
Process: cut the corners and the quality won't come back.
Technology: bolt new tools onto a broken floor —
The ledge is thinner the higher you ignore.
Six-sigma isn't perfection — it's the standard that you set:
The disciplined climber is the one who isn't finished yet.


[Final Chorus]
SIX SIGMA LEDGE — hold the line, hold the line!
SIX SIGMA LEDGE — step off and you decline!
Quality at volume is a discipline not a wish —
SIX SIGMA LEDGE — one slip and you miss!
HOLD — THE — LINE.
3.4. Not 3.5.


________________

Spreadsheet North Star —
One point, clear sky.
Spreadsheet North Star —

Spreadsheet North Star — set it and invest.
One point, clear sky.
